summary.text: Bill Coleman is a candidate of the Vermont Progressive Party and the Democratic Party for the Vermont House of Representatives, Caledonia-3 District (2 seats), in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as public policy advocate, and in a Ballotpedia survey he said he has worked in psychology for nearly 30 years.

paragraphs.text: Bill Coleman earned a high school diploma from Stowe High School, a bachelor's degree from Goddard College in 1982, and a graduate degree from Springfield College in 2013.
His career experience includes working as a public policy advocate.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Coleman said his primary residence has been in Newark, Vermont, since 1984, and that he has worked in psychology for nearly 30 years, mostly in small therapeutic communities of 6 to 12 residents or as a Shared Living Provider.
In the survey, Coleman said solutions to health care financing must involve single-payer Medicaid for all, which he said would lower school taxes.
He also said he supports renewable energy and action on climate change, and that he is concerned about threats to democracy.
